title: rework_route and synthesize execute — NEVER_EXECUTED empties
description: The last two unreached nodes. When they execute, every node in the committed topology has run at least once.

successCriteria.description: A golden case drives rework_route to execution with span status 'ok'.
A golden case drives synthesize to execution with span status 'ok'.
NEVER_EXECUTED is empty, and the guard that fails when a node re-enters it is still present and still bites.
Node coverage reports every node in the committed topology as executed, asserted against the artifact rather than a hardcoded count.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, and the golden gate passing at or above its replay floor.

nonGoals: Relaxing the span-status-ok rule to make a node count as covered.
stopConditions: A node is genuinely unreachable in the committed topology — that is a topology finding worth more than the coverage number; record it.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, the golden gate passing, and every documentation claim added backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: With the list empty, the guard's shape changes: it can no longer assert 'these are unreachable and here is why'. Replace it with the equivalent positive claim — every node executed — keeping a control that fails if coverage regresses. Do not simply delete the guard. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
evaluatorNotes: An empty list is exactly where a guard rots into a no-op. Verify the replacement genuinely fails when a node stops executing — remove a case in a scratch edit and confirm it reports. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
